from scipy.optimize import least_squares
np.random.seed(0)
def run(f,p0,name,n=20):
    best=None
    for s in range(n):
        p=np.array(p0,float)*(1+0.6*np.random.randn(len(p0))) if s else np.array(p0,float)
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda q: f(q)-dP_dt,p,max_nfev=2000)
            if np.all(np.isfinite(r.fun)) and (best is None or r.cost<best.cost): best=r
        except Exception: pass
    print(name, np.mean(best.fun**2)/np.var(dP_dt), np.round(best.x,4))
